senses.gloss: m. (חָתַם; cmp. טָפוּס) baker of bread in moulds, professional baker.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Challah 1:7">Tosef. Ḥall. I, 7</cite> <he>נ׳ אחד מארבעים וכ׳</he> the professional baker has to give one forty-eighth portion of his dough to the priest, opp. <he>בעל הבית</he> a private baker; Y. ib. II, end, 58ᵈ.
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 2:7">Ḥall. II, 7</cite> <he>נ׳ שהוא עושה למכור בשוק</he> the baker that makes bread for sale in the market.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 5:4:2">Y. Dem. V, 24ᵈ</cite> top <he>נ׳ עושה טפוס אחד וכ׳</he> each baker makes his own peculiar form of bread, while the dealer (<cite ref="Q01026"><he>פלטר</he></cite>) deals with many bakers; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 5:4:2">ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ עושה כמה טפוסין וכ׳</he> a baker makes several forms, while the dealer deals with one baker; a. fr.—<he>ר׳ יהודה הנ׳</he> R. Judah, the baker, prob. identical with R. Judah ben Baba.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:10">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 18:13">Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 13</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>נַחְתּוּמִים</he>, <he>נַחְתּוּמִין</he>. Y. Ḥall. l. c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:2">Kel. XV, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="A03028"><he>אֲרוּכָה</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
